adaptations: The dynamically written TypeScript extensions are represented by one compiled Rust JSON-RPC subprocess fixture selected through the native configuration handshake.
The host-rendered controlled pane input preserves Hunk's focused editor ownership while keeping rendering and cursor placement in Ratatui's cell buffer.
The 200-row interactive file-view fixture returns handled for n and pass for j, and the test compares both current-line and scroll state at 120 by 24 cells.
The focused review stream is modeled by moving the native current-line cursor into a scrollable 80-line replacement before opening each modal surface.
